A note about illness, symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment of a disease.
A note about exercise, workouts, physical training, or fitness activities.
A personal view, judgment, evaluation, interpretation, or argument.
An inspiration or sudden insight that may lead to a new idea.
A design concept, architecture, or proposed arrangement of components.
A concrete idea, suggestion, or creative concept.
An idea, thought, possibility, or proposed approach.

A record of everyday events, routines, activities, or ordinary experiences.
